# TauCeti dependency

This repository vendors 39 unchanged Lean source files from the TauCeti project,
revision `1c497c347f615b3087cb605f8cf743e591376105`. They supply verified
Sturm–Tarski and sign-determination foundations.

- Upstream: https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCeti
- Authors: Kim Morrison and the Tau Ceti contributors, as recorded in each source header.
- License: Apache-2.0; the complete text is in LICENSE.
- Per-file source URLs and SHA-256 hashes are in provenance.json.
- Local source modifications: none.

These are pre-existing external library results, not mathematics developed
during the Mathathon. They do not by themselves implement the project's
parameterized nonlinear quantifier elimination.
